text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's just as Parcae predicted. I won... I 
won, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (――Not winning like *this*, dammit!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(There was a guaranteed winning pattern. 
Yet they won without even taking that 
"optimal route.")

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In other words...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Air Shakur already left? It's the 
Satsuki Sho, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't she feel any joy from winning? 
Huh... that's a bit surprising."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, something she hadn't 
anticipated— something outside Parcae's 
calculations— had occurred.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly chased after Air Shakur... She 
was breathing quietly with her shoulders 
rising and falling, staring at the 
computer screen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaahhhhh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The answer changed even further, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That 7 cm... had shrunk down to 3 cm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just 3 cm... only 3 cm... If this reaches 
zero—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whew... Wait, hold on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even so, all it did was close the gap in 
the numbers for the "optimal route."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not down to zero yet. Besides, this 
could be the pattern where she wins the 
Satsuki Sho and loses the Tokyo Yushun and 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then either way, it is a path that "ends."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"First, I gotta bring it up to the 
theoretical limit where I only lose by 7 
cm, then re-examine the factors to bring 
that difference to zero..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You head on back first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could answer, Air Shakur had 
already left. She probably wanted to sort 
things out somewhere she could focus. As I 
thought that—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? Guess she really is like 
that normally too... pretty selfish, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even though everyone was clapping... Hmm, 
so that girl's going to be the lead...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...All the voices will vanish as long as 
that 7cm gap changes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur will definitely deliver results 
at the Nippon Derby as well. When that 
happens, the perceptions around her should 
change too.
choice_data_list:
(More than anything, Air Shakur's strength 
is the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she continues stacking up victories in 
major races from here on out, her charm is 
sure to shine through――"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really startin' to change?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I won't have that damn nightmare anymore 
either... It's gonna end. It'll end, and 
begin anew...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Only 3 centimeters left. Once that hits 
zero, I'll...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――But... what if that three centimeters 
never shrinks any further?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If destiny remains unchanged, and we were 
merely toyed with by false hope..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, no... no.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Think, squeeze every drop out, scrape it 
all together. I still can't see the tail 
of the Goddess of Victory. But—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I gotta take it by force, I'm 
makin' it mine...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Just you wait... Japanese Derby!"
